content.text:
I've finished and submitted. The best composition I measured is **index 6 (Sb fraction 0.375), with an EQE of 0.386%**.

I used all 5 EQE measurements and none of the 5 XRD measurements:

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 0.247 | 0.071 |
| 6 | 0.375 | **0.386** |
| 9 | 0.493 | 0.124 |
| 11 | 0.574 | 0.285 |
| 20 | 0.813 | 0.007 |

- **The curve has two peaks.** EQE dips at Sb 0.49, which is the AgSbO₃ composition, and rises on both sides of it.
- **Possible explanation, not checked:** AgSbO₃ may absorb too little of the 2.1 eV light, and mixed phases on either side may do better. I didn't run XRD or the band-gap and structure tools to confirm this.
- **The true best may be unmeasured.** The two gaps next to index 6 (Sb 0.25–0.37 and 0.37–0.49) and the region around index 11 (Sb 0.49–0.63) were never sampled. A higher-EQE composition could be there. With no EQE budget left, those compositions can't count toward the score.
